desc: Derive edge-contribution coefficients by relative position of edge index i to u<v: i<u gives 2(i-1)/(i(i+1)), i=u gives (u-1)/u for u>=2, u<i<v gives 1/i, i=v gives 1, and i>v gives 0.
Implement complete Python solution: read stdin, precompute modular inverses 1..N, factorial (N-1)!, prefixC and prefixInv arrays, process Q queries in O(1), and write answers modulo 998244353.
Validate the implementation on samples 1, 2, 3; all three public samples PASS.
